safety_student_discipline_003.answer: yes. Principal/designee reviews allegations and issues suspension notices; Hearing Officer conducts fact-finding and decides on expulsion or alternative placement; IEP Committee determines if offenses are manifestations of disability. References Code of Student Conduct 3.09.
safety_student_discipline_003.evidence: The principal (or designee), after reviewing the allegations and evidence against a student... is initially responsible for deciding that a Class III offense has been committed. ... Hearing Officer ... Individualized Education Program Committee
